## Introduction

Energy demand refers to the amount of energy used by households, businesses, industries, transportation systems, and other parts of society.

Demand changes over time because of factors such as:

- weather;
- population;
- economic activity;
- technology;
- energy prices;
- consumer behavior.

## Electricity Demand

Electricity demand can change significantly during a single day.

For example, demand may rise when people return home, turn on lights, prepare meals, and use heating or cooling systems.

Understanding these changes helps utilities plan electricity generation and maintain a reliable power system.

## Why It Matters

Energy-demand analysis supports decisions related to:

- power-system planning;
- renewable-energy integration;
- energy efficiency;
- infrastructure investment;
- climate and energy policy.
